svg.title: micrograd
svg.desc: micrograd: scalar autograd engine plus a NumPy statevector simulator trained with the parameter-shift rule. Figure: make_moons decision boundaries of a 25-parameter MLP (2-6-1) and a 26-parameter 2-qubit, 3-layer variational circuit. Mean test accuracy over 5 seeds: circuit 97.5%, MLP 99.4%. No quantum advantage.
